name: Application Layer Protocol: DNS
description: Adversaries may communicate using the Domain Name System (DNS) application layer protocol to avoid detection/network filtering.

name: Phishing (Mobile / Messaging)
description: Adversaries may send phishing messages via SMS, messaging apps, or social platforms to trick users into divulging credentials or OTP codes.
d3fend_countermeasure: D3-UA (URL Analysis) / D3-MHA (Message Header & Content Analysis)

name: Phishing: Spearphishing Link
description: Adversaries send spearphishing messages with a malicious link to harvest credentials or session tokens.

name: Brute Force: Password Guessing
description: Adversaries may systematically guess passwords via repetitive login attempts.

name: Command and Scripting Interpreter
description: Unusual process execution followed by outbound network connection.

name: Exploitation for Privilege Escalation / Permission Abuse
description: Apps requesting invasive dangerous permissions (SMS, Accessibility, Call Log) outside expected functional scope.

name: Exfiltration Over C2 / Unusual Outbound Metadata
description: Sensitive local resource access closely followed by high-entropy or unusual outbound connection metadata.
